metadata.dataset_source: Spider 1.0 / concert_singer. 10 preguntas representativas. Para cada pregunta se conocen las tablas y columnas gold que el APS debe recuperar via similarity search.
metadata.design_principle: Variar la metrica de similitud (cosine / ip / l2) y medir F1 sobre la recuperacion de tablas y columnas. Hiperparametros del LLM y embeddings se mantienen fijos.

samples.refined_query: List the names of singers who performed in concerts at stadiums with a capacity over 5000.
What is the most common theme among concerts performed by singers from France?
Show the name of the singer who performed in the most recent concert.
Show the name and the release year of the song by the youngest singer.
What are all distinct countries where singers above age 20 are from?
List all song names by singers above the average age.
Show location and name for all stadiums with a capacity between 5000 and 10000.
Show the names of singers whose songs are not from any concert.
Show the names of stadiums that did not have any concert.
Show stadium names and the highest year of concerts in each stadium.
